summary: Takeaway.com is dutch online food ordering company, founded in 1999. Type: listed company. About 900 employees (Wikidata). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about acquisitions.

culture.text: Online food-delivery platform connecting restaurants with customers, part of Just Eat Takeaway.com.

open.text: Three Takeaway.com entities, including Central Core B.V. and Group B.V., are IND recognised visa sponsors.

growth.text: Is shutting down its operations in Bulgaria after 20 years.

worth_knowing.text: Just Eat Takeaway left the Euronext stock exchange after its takeover by Prosus.
In Belgium it started using self-employed couriers, and a union called on the government to step in.
